hook: "most y'all just run all products dpa ads" — calls out the lazy default setup.
body: Advises testing segmented product sets in Meta DPA instead of one all-products catalog: best sellers, new drops, and per-category sets (shirts, bottoms, hats, socks), claiming wide-and-deep DPA structure gets extreme scale when executed properly.
idea: DPA scale comes from product-set segmentation, not a single all-products catalog — slice the catalog into intent-matched sets.
sequencing: The alternative: test into new product sets
Examples of sets (best sellers, new drops, per-category)
The payoff claim (super wide and deep → extreme scale)
why_it_works: Segmented product sets match the ad to the viewer's demonstrated intent (viewed necklaces → necklace set), which raises relevance and lets Meta optimize within a tighter, higher-intent pool.
what_to_steal: Build LC DPA product sets by collection (best sellers, new drops, hoops, chains, tennis) instead of one all-products catalog.
